name: Doxepin, low dose
class: Tricyclic H1 antagonist at hypnotic dose
description: Doxepin at 3 to 6 mg, far below its antidepressant dose range, approved as Silenor for sleep maintenance insomnia. At this dose it acts as a selective histamine H1 antagonist.

systems.note: Selective H1 antagonism at the hypnotic dose; the labelled indication.
Tricyclic class hepatic injury is documented at antidepressant doses.
Tricyclic class cardiac conduction effects, minimal at the hypnotic dose.

monitors.why: Tricyclic class hepatic injury, documented at higher doses.
Antidepressant class boxed suicidality warning applies to the labelling.
